14: /-! # Relations: Confluence and Termination
15: 
16: This module proves some properties regarding confluence and termination that are used for both
17: lambda calculi and combinatory logic. Some notable theorems:
18: 
19: * `Diamond.toConfluent`: the diamond property implies confluence
20: * `LocallyConfluent.Terminating_toConfluent`: Newman's lemma
21: 
22: ## References
23: 
24: * [*Term Rewriting and All That*][Baader1998]
25: 
26: -/

32: theorem WellFounded.ofTransGen (trans_wf : WellFounded (Relation.TransGen r)) : WellFounded r := by
33:   grind [WellFounded.wellFounded_iff_has_min, Relation.TransGen]
34: 
35: @[simp, grind =]
36: theorem WellFounded.iff_transGen : WellFounded (Relation.TransGen r) ↔ WellFounded r :=
37:   ⟨ofTransGen, transGen⟩

39: namespace Relation
40: 
41: attribute [scoped grind] ReflGen TransGen ReflTransGen EqvGen CompRel
42: 
43: theorem ReflGen.to_eqvGen (h : ReflGen r a b) : EqvGen r a b := by
44:   induction h <;> grind
45:

56:   SymmGen.to_eqvGen

58: theorem MJoin.refl (a : α) : MJoin r a a := by
59:   use a
60: 
61: theorem MJoin.single (h : ReflTransGen r a b) : MJoin r a b := by
62:   use b
63: 
64: /-- Extending a multistep reduction by a single step preserves multi-joinability. -/
65: lemma Diamond.extend (h : Diamond r) :
66:     ReflTransGen r a b → r a c → Join (ReflTransGen r) b c := by
67:   intros ab ac
68:   induction ab using ReflTransGen.head_induction_on generalizing c
69:   case refl => exists c, .single ac
70:   case head a'_c' _ ih =>
71:     obtain ⟨d, cd, c'_d⟩ := h ac a'_c'
72:     obtain ⟨d', b_d', d_d'⟩ := ih c'_d
73:     exact ⟨d', b_d', .head cd d_d'⟩
74: 
75: /-- The diamond property implies confluence. -/
76: theorem Diamond.toConfluent (h : Diamond r) : Confluent r := by
77:   intros a b c ab bc
78:   induction ab using ReflTransGen.head_induction_on generalizing c
79:   case refl => exists c
80:   case head _ _ a'_c' _ ih =>
81:     obtain ⟨d, cd, c'_d⟩ := h.extend bc a'_c'
82:     obtain ⟨d', b_d', d_d'⟩ := ih c'_d
83:     exact ⟨d', b_d', .trans cd d_d'⟩
84: 
85: theorem Confluent.toChurchRosser (h : Confluent r) : ChurchRosser r := by
86:   intro x y h_eqv
87:   induction h_eqv with
88:   | rel _ b => exists b; grind [ReflTransGen.single]
89:   | refl a => exists a
90:   | symm a b _ ih => exact symm ih
91:   | trans _ _ _ _ _ ih1 ih2 =>
92:       obtain ⟨u, _, hbu⟩ := ih1
93:       obtain ⟨v, hbv, _⟩ := ih2
94:       obtain ⟨w, _, _⟩ := h hbu hbv
95:       exists w
96:       grind [ReflTransGen.trans]
97: 
98: theorem SemiConfluent.toConfluent (h : SemiConfluent r) : Confluent r := by
99:   intro x y1 y2 h_xy1 h_xy2
100:   induction h_xy1 with
101:   | refl => use y2
102:   | tail h_xz h_zy1 ih =>
103:       obtain ⟨u, h_zu, _⟩ := ih
104:       obtain ⟨v, _, _⟩ := h h_zu h_zy1
105:       exists v
106:       grind [ReflTransGen.trans]
107: 
108: attribute [scoped grind →] Confluent.toChurchRosser SemiConfluent.toConfluent

110: private theorem confluent_equivalents : [ChurchRosser r, SemiConfluent r, Confluent r].TFAE := by
111:   grind [List.tfae_cons_cons, List.tfae_singleton]
112: 
113: theorem SemiConfluent_iff_ChurchRosser : SemiConfluent r ↔ ChurchRosser r :=
114:   List.TFAE.out confluent_equivalents 1 0
115: 
116: theorem Confluent_iff_ChurchRosser : Confluent r ↔ ChurchRosser r :=
117:   List.TFAE.out confluent_equivalents 2 0
118: 
119: theorem Confluent_iff_SemiConfluent : Confluent r ↔ SemiConfluent r :=
120:   List.TFAE.out confluent_equivalents 2 1
121: 
122: theorem Confluent_of_unique_end {x : α} (h : ∀ y : α, ReflTransGen r y x) : Confluent r := by
123:   intro a b c hab hac
124:   exact ⟨x, h b, h c⟩
125: 
126: theorem Normal_iff (r : α → α → Prop) (x : α) : Normal r x ↔ ∀ y, ¬ r x y := by
127:   rw [Normal, not_exists]
128: 
129: /-- A multi-step from a normal form must be reflexive. -/
130: @[grind =>]
131: theorem Normal.reflTransGen_eq (h : Normal r x) (xy : ReflTransGen r x y) : x = y := by
132:   induction xy <;> grind
133: 
134: /-- For a Church-Rosser relation, elements in an equivalence class must be multi-step related. -/
135: theorem ChurchRosser.normal_eqvGen_reflTransGen (cr : ChurchRosser r) (norm : Normal r x)
136:     (xy : EqvGen r y x) : ReflTransGen r y x := by
137:   have ⟨_, _, _⟩ := cr xy
138:   grind
139: 
140: /-- For a Church-Rosser relation there is one normal form in each equivalence class. -/
141: theorem ChurchRosser.normal_eq (cr : ChurchRosser r) (nx : Normal r x) (ny : Normal r y)
142:     (xy : EqvGen r x y) : x = y := by
143:   have ⟨z, _, _⟩ := cr xy
144:   grind
145: 
146: /-- Confluence implies that multi-step joinability is an equivalence. -/
147: theorem Confluent.equivalence_join_reflTransGen (h : Confluent r) :
148:     Equivalence (Join (ReflTransGen r)) := by
149:   apply equivalence_join
150:   grind
151:

153: lemma SN_iff_SN_of_rel (x : α) : SN r x ↔ ∀ y, r x y → SN r y := by grind only [Acc]
154: 
155: lemma SN.intro : (h : ∀ y, r x y → SN r y) → SN r x := (SN_iff_SN_of_rel x).mpr
156: 
157: lemma SN.of_rel (hx : SN r x) (h : r x y) : SN r y := Acc.inv hx h

160: lemma SN.of_rel_reflTransGen (hx : SN r x) (h : ReflTransGen r x y) : SN r y := by
161:   induction h with
162:   | refl => exact hx
163:   | tail _ h ih => exact ih.of_rel h

166:   have eq : TransGen (Function.swap r) = (fun a b => TransGen r b a) := by
167:     ext
168:     exact transGen_swap
169:   simpa [eq] using Acc.transGen hx

172:   refine Subrelation.accessible ?_ hx

177:   ⟨fun hx => hx.of_le <| fun _ _ => TransGen.single, transGen⟩
